purpose: preserve all area coefficients; qualify native enable/valid boundary using semantic control-load contexts
prior_independent_labels: permanently excluded; original coefficients as an immutable total-bank diagnostic baseline only
grouping: one semantic synthetic source and all its exact clock/stage variants stay in one split; normalized semantic signatures must be unique across sources
reset: synchronous active-low; per-channel zero/ones/alternating/hash-derived general bit patterns; same logical value reset along its lifetime
source_relations: kept combinational two-input XOR/permutation/inversion adapters over shared registered roots; every semantic state bit observed exactly once; adapter arithmetic excluded from owned state area
relation_limit: synthetic affine two-root-bit relations only; arbitrary arithmetic source correlation still requires joint G qualification
lifetime: contiguous native lifetime; include no-full-chain layouts; channels born after first cut and channels ending before last cut; valid always advances inside native bank
known_bits: all dynamic, high/low zero padding, interior zero holes including 37-bit/36-variable and66-bit/64-variable layouts
service_protocols: one shared write enable including input-valid
independent data write enables with continuously advancing input-valid
external_protocol: unconditional output data/valid capture from declared terminal native values; never gated by valid
ownership: disjoint input_service/native_state/external_state/adapter/observer/shared_clock/shared_physical/root_boundary_repair; retain every class; unknown functional cells or FF geometry mismatches reject
diagnostic_baseline: immutable_native_total_baseline; original unpartitioned total is not eligible as a per-owner joint addend
model_features: semantic bits/signals/reset-one bits/capture-enable domains/widths/known masks/shared-source and lifetime descriptors/SDC only; no mapped cell counts, timing, area or source/split IDs
state_area_label: input_service, native_state and external_state owned functional state/control area separately; shared physical/clock/repair labels retained separately, never silently added twice to a joint stage
selection: train-only nonnegative least squares; original gates on validation; normalized MAE, serialized size and stable candidate order break ties; parameters/domain/reserve frozen before fresh test

boundary.birth_adapter_path: diagnostic only; not a state-only control bound or D_ref
boundary.test_gate: all eight non-birth paths at each exact registered clock; independent max(H+delay)<=frozen upper bound; all three unchanged area models pass original20%/50%
boundary.model_features: semantic per-cut fanout only; no mapped cell count, path delay or PPA in query features

mapping_reuse: none in this cohort; each target gets independent synthesis and fresh SDC/ODB; all leaves paid
observation: post-state observer receives each service/native/external data and valid state exactly once; prevents unused-output pruning; observer area excluded
SDC_validation: strict serialized-sdc v2 syntax plus exact binary32-second IO storage and write_sdc decimal rounding; no relative tolerance or target change
predecessor_stop: four successful synth probes retained as diagnostic only; no grt; two SDC storage checks and two missing native-valid paths exposed unused output pruning; new versioned sources require new synthesis
area_coefficients_policy: byte-identical area models from frozen parent candidate; no refit; all owner area gates checked on successor validation and new independent test
immutable_boundary_paths: native_data/external_data/external_valid/input_data/input_enable/input_valid retain exact parent per-clock bounds; all must pass successor qualification
reuse: only the old162 train/validation rows at exact physical identity; old54 consumed test never used for fitting, selection, calibration, margins or domain choices
source_population: 24 newly salted sources with explicit per-cut load/lifetime distributions; 12train/6validation/6lockedtest and nine exact frozen targets; exclude every prior semantic signature
source_independence: new reset/source-relation/lifetime and control-load contexts at already exposed widths; not unseen widths or arbitrary arithmetic correlation
boundary_fitting: only native_enable/native_valid H+delay per stage; NNLS on fixed features, optionally nine exact-clock indicators; upper correction=max(0,max train required-prediction), original engineering reserve remains50ps; baseline=max train H+delay+50ps pooled across registered clocks
boundary_selection: entire two-path candidate per stage must cover every old/new validation row; lowest mean validation predicted upper bound, then serialized bytes, then stable declared order; no independent labels observed
post_collection: raw replay; unchanged areas and six unchanged path classes must pass validation; fit the two control paths; freeze/reproduce; then separately admit54 new test; no automatic fitting or test
